## 🤔 Too large for the model

The task, the pull request description and this PR's changes don't fit the input window of the model that checks business logic (6000 tokens): not one changed file fits beside the task. Nothing was checked. A model with a larger window in the Business Logic settings, or a shorter task, lets Kody read the code.

## 🤔 The model's answer limit leaves no room for the code

The model that checks business logic is set to write up to 14000 tokens (its max output tokens, plus its thinking budget on Anthropic and Bedrock), and its input window is 16000 tokens: the provider counts both against the window, so this PR's changes don't fit beside the task and the answer. Nothing was checked. Lower that model's max output tokens or reasoning effort in the Business Logic settings, or pick a model with a larger window.
